text: BAM share rose 1.55 percentage points over 25 hours and 1.32 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 35.9% of Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 25.2% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 leadership changes this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not validator turnover.
